Lemon chickpea pasta
Serves 4
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 15 minutes

Ingredients
250 g pasta
1 x 400g tin chickpeas, drained
1 lemon, zested

Method
1. Cook the pasta until tender.
2. Add the chickpeas and lemon zest, then toss together.

Tomato toast
Serves 2
Ingredients
1 x 400g tin tomatoes
a generous handful basil
salt to taste
2 slices bread
Method
Toast the bread. Spoon over the tomatoes and finish with basil and salt.
